summary: Hannah Taylor, 39, died in a fall on the northwest ridge of Willow Peak (The Thorne area) when a handhold pulled loose; a Black Hawk helicopter flew over Deluge Lake during the response
location: Willow Peak northwest ridge (The Thorne), Gore Range, near Silverthorne
notes: Forum thread titled The Thorne Climbing Accident. Victim was managing director of Summit Huts. Secondary URL surfaced via search and not opened this turn. | 2026-09-15: 14ers.com link removed per site ban; row retains other verified source(s).
